spawnradius.screen.title: Spawn Rings
spawnradius.screen.legend.tooltip: Explains each ring in the top-left corner of the map.
spawnradius.screen.outline.tooltip: Draws a thin dark edge around the rings so they stay readable on any terrain.
spawnradius.screen.y_mode.tooltip:
Spawn and despawn distances are spherical, so height counts too. The map is top-down, so the rings show a slice at one Y level.

Player's Y: rings are drawn at full radius.
Fixed Y: rings are drawn with the smaller radius that really applies at that height. Enter your farm platform's height, for example.
spawnradius.screen.fixed_y.tooltip: The mobs' feet level: the top surface of the spawning platform (platform block Y + 1).
spawnradius.screen.center.tooltip:
Player: the rings follow you.
Pinned: the rings stay at a saved point, e.g. your AFK spot.

Use "Pin here" to save your current position.
spawnradius.screen.pin_here.tooltip: Saves your current position (X, Y, Z and dimension) as the ring centre.
spawnradius.screen.spawn_chunks.tooltip:
Shades the chunks where the server runs mob spawning in green. A chunk spawns mobs only if:

• its centre is less than 128 blocks from the player horizontally, and
• it is inside the server's simulation distance (read from the server automatically).
spawnradius.screen.world_spawn.tooltip: The game never spawns mobs naturally within %s blocks of the world spawn point. Shows that area as a white ring (only in the spawn point's dimension).
spawnradius.screen.reset.tooltip: Resets every option. The pinned position is kept.
spawnradius.screen.reset.title: Reset all options to their defaults?
spawnradius.screen.note: Named mobs, mobs that picked up items and persistent mobs (most animals) never despawn.
spawnradius.tooltip.no_spawn:
Natural spawning never places a mob closer than %s blocks (spherical distance) to a player.

This rule is for natural spawning. Spawners and special events (raids, patrols, etc.) use their own rules.
spawnradius.tooltip.random_despawn: A mob that stays more than %s blocks from every player for a while (normally 30 seconds) has a 1/800 chance to despawn every tick. Inside this distance there is no random despawn.
spawnradius.tooltip.instant_despawn: A mob more than %s blocks from every player is removed immediately. A mob farm's spawning area must be inside this ring.
spawnradius.legend.title: Spawn Rings
spawnradius.legend.other_dimension: The map shows another dimension. Rings only appear in the dimension you are in.
spawnradius.legend.pin_other_dimension: The pinned centre is in another dimension.
spawnradius.legend.world_spawn: World spawn: no spawning within %s blocks
